defect: The inherited PACK stop-only position sets a binary64 raw stop but rounds only eventual executable fills. The proposal's inherited adverse tick rules did not explicitly define a tick-valid protective trigger. No real C260 rows, evaluation identity or economics have been opened; synthetic fixture checks exposed this implementation gap.

long_trigger.raw_stop: Compute binary64 raw_stop=entry_exec-2.0*ATR24 exactly as the frozen stop-only position; entry_exec is the adverse tick-valid executable entry at the applicable base or stressed slippage.
long_trigger.rounding: trigger=floor(Decimal(str(raw_stop))/Decimal(str(tick)))*Decimal(str(tick)). Floor is the inherited adverse SELL direction: the trigger is never rounded toward entry to improve the modeled exit.
long_trigger.protection: Require a positive tick-valid trigger below executable entry and below the causally completed entry mark. A stop that cannot be placed is an explicit pre-exposure protection skip; do not enter and manufacture protection afterward.
long_trigger.sizing: Recalculate conservative stressed round-trip modeled initial risk, quantity floor, gross/open-risk constraints and stop feasibility from this exact trigger. No quantity upsize, maxQty clipping or use of a narrower unrounded stop to understate risk.
long_trigger.lifecycle: Use that immutable trigger for gap/range detection, mandatory stop execution and all reported risk. Keep 72-hour due-open exit, no target/partials/adds/trailing. Mandatory raw exit/reference or exchange-rule failures retain exposure and known costs as INCOMPLETE.

raw_price_and_quantity_validity: Authenticate raw reference prices against the frozen filter tick before adverse executable-price rounding. Pre-exposure infeasibility is an explicit skip; a mandatory exposed exit failure is INCOMPLETE. Use exact Decimal filter arithmetic or explicitly bounded absolute-error checks with relative tolerance zero; a large quantity must not acquire an off-step allowance from relative tolerance.
funding_mark: Match accepted C259 chronological phase semantics using the completed raw mark bar at open_ms=funding_time-1h and its close, not the bar an additional hour earlier. Entry-time funding is excluded; funding precedes actual gap/due exits; a prior-range exit at that boundary precedes its funding. No assumed zero or eight-hour default.
phase_equity: Every recorded cashflow phase retains causally marked remaining exposure. Pending prior-range exits use their actual exit reference rather than a later post-stop bar close; surviving exposure uses the causally completed mark. A new cashflow timestamp never resets open movement to zero or combines fresh settled cash with stale surviving-lot marks.
source_integrity: Authenticate source byte digest and length before economic parsing. Inspect only timestamp envelopes for clipping; economic fields outside the authorized window remain uninterpreted. Unbound sources cannot produce evidence or consume a real evaluation identity.
trial_disclosure: One preregistered primary, no real outcome comparison or parameter search. Retain this pre-read clarification and the original proposal permanently. This is not a post-result adjustment, a second evaluated variant or a qualification claim.
unchanged: Signal, side, universe, ranks, decision/entry clocks, stop distance parameter, 72-hour holding, costs, capital books, risk fractions/caps, economic sample/PF/mean/CI/p-screen gates, bootstrap, DD tiers and sealed-window discipline remain unchanged. Independent exact-head review and protected source/code/registration gates remain required before real evaluation.
